summary: @servicetitan/microfront-tests preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall lifecycle script (setup.mjs) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13) and uses execFileSync to run a shipped 727KB obfuscated bundle (math_init.js) under Bun at install time. setup.mjs is itself obfuscator.io-mangled (hex identifiers, per-scope string dictionaries) to hide platform detection, archive download, extraction, chmod, and exec logic. math_init.js carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and obfuscator.io fingerprints (string-array rotator function, hex-mangled identifiers, large numeric string array) with no readable code and no relation to the package's advertised microfrontend test utilities (whose actual source is ~3KB of trivial DI/container code). Executing an opaque, obfuscated bundle under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at install time places attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine outside the Node analysis surface.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
